target_customer: Small and medium sized enterprises in Spain and Portugal needing corporate cards and expense management
problem: SMEs struggle to manage employee expenses, reimbursements, VAT recovery and cards across disconnected tools.
business_model: SaaS subscription plus card interchange, with 3% cashback offered to customers

founders.name: Eduardo Ortiz de Lanzagorta Gonzalez
education: Universidad Politecnica de Madrid, Industrial Organization Engineering
previous_startups: First VC-backed fintech started during his degree
Co-founded a Spanish seed fund that backed over 40 companies

exit.reason: Cash and equity deal for technology, clients and team; Factorial says it formalised the deal on 2023-09-27.

competitors.name: Payhawk
competitors.what: Spend management and corporate cards entering Spain
competitors.traction_then: Spanish team grew to 24 people by Nov 2022 with customers like Wallapop

technical_complexity.rationale: Card issuing partnerships, ERP integrations, VAT recovery and reconciliation were standard fintech engineering with regulatory dependencies.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with accounting and cards creates some lock-in, but European competitors and banks offered similar tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Spanish HR software firm Factorial acquired Fuell in 2023 to enter expenses.

market_need_then: Spanish SMEs lacked integrated cards plus expense tools; Fuell offered 3% cashback and VAT recovery; European spend management entrants were arriving in 2022.

branding.domain_note: Used getfuell.com; now redirects to factorialhr.com.
branding.community_and_virality: No community or merch evidence; press spelled the name inconsistently as Fuel in places.

brand_strength.rationale: Regional brand with press from the round and the sale; double L spelling caused confusion with fuel cards.

outcome_analysis: Fuell, founded in 2019 in Madrid and in YC W22, closed a EUR 1.5M round led by YC and Fin Capital in July 2022 to consolidate Spain and Portugal and launch in Italy. Factorial acquired it in October 2023 for an undisclosed cash and equity price in its first acquisition, absorbing the technology, clients and team. A 23 person team and a sale about 15 months after the round point to a strategic exit rather than a failure.
notes: Round was EUR 1.5M; amount_usd left null rather than converting. Investor lists vary by outlet (one adds TheVentureCity, K Fund, Wayra). One database lists Fuell as bankrupt, contradicting Factorial's acquisition; not verified. Payhawk began in Spain around Nov 2020 per its anniversary post, so it predates the batch. Circula's Oct 2022 Spain entry came after the batch and is excluded.
